description: A chat's draft, as its host keeps it: the text written in its box and not sent, the same on every head that opens the chat, on any machine. Only the text: what's attached is a file on the head's own machine, kept there.

rev.description: Its revision: one more with every save, never less (a head drops one it's seen a later revision than).

head.description: The box that wrote it (draft_save's head): what that box knows as its own save, coming back.

epoch.description: How many times it's been emptied by a send (none: 0): one more with every send, never less. A save written before the last send (its epoch less) is refused, and a head drops a draft of an epoch less than one it's seen, so what was sent never comes back.

sent.description: The send that last emptied it (draft_save's sent): the same send's save, made again, empties it once.

at.description: When it was written, epoch seconds.
